Hi Lena —

Great to meet today. Quick recap and a few follow-ups so we can size a hosted API proposal that matches your expected unit economics. Thanks for the context on the product and typical user flows. To confirm a few items we discussed on the call: 

1) Expected monthly token volume (all requests, includes prompts + completions): can you confirm a ballpark range? (e.g., 10M / 50M / 200M tokens/month)
2) Peak TPS (requests/sec) and whether peak is sustained or short bursts (e.g., 1-15 min spikes)
3) Average tokens per request (prompt + completion) — rough average helps estimate RPS and concurrency
4) Target $/1M tokens or monthly budget range for hosted inference

I attached a short spreadsheet (redwood-pricing-questions.xlsx) with the fields above — if you can fill the numbers it will speed up a formal quote.

Next steps from our side: once we have these numbers I’ll put together two options: (a) pay-as-you-go hosted pricing and (b) committed monthly volume with a unit-price discount. We’ll also include recommended config to reduce unit costs (caching, batching, model variant suggestions).

Thanks — appreciate the quick turn.

— Ben

Thanks Lena — this is perfect and very helpful. A few quick clarifying notes and an initial pricing sketch: 

Clarifying Qs:
- The 18 TPS peak: is that predominantly reads (inference-only) or do you have prompt-heavy flows that increase prompt tokens during peak?
- Are there any latency SLOs we should guarantee (p95 targets)?

Initial pricing sketch (hosted API):
- Pay-as-you-go: $220 per 1M tokens (no minimum) — good for pilots but higher unit cost
- Committed volume (12-month commit, 75M/month starting): $95 per 1M tokens with a 5% overage buffer — includes standard SLA and basic observability
- Add-ons: 24/7 SLAs, longer retention, and private deployment options will increase the effective unit price — we can line-item those

Cost reduction levers: intelligent batching + prefix caching, smaller model variant for lower-cost paths, and request consolidation for notifications. For your volume (75M/mo) the committed plan at ~$95/1M looks achievable and puts you within the $6k-$12k/month band you cited (75M * $95/1M ≈ $7,125/month).

I’ve attached a short proposal PDF and a mutual action plan. If the unit pricing is in the ballpark, next step is:
1) schedule a solutions-engineer deep-dive (30-45 min) to validate peak concurrency and latency SLOs
2) procurement and legal to review a draft MSA — I’ll circulate a starter if you want to see typical terms

Available times for the tech call: Tue 3/3 10:00–12:00 PST or Wed 3/4 14:00–16:00 PST. Let me know what works and I’ll loop in Marissa (solutions lead).

— Ben
